relations: The stationary split wood pieces provide a fixed base for the flickering and shifting orange flames.
The initial tall flame column wavers, narrows, and fades into thin wisps over time.
As the high detached flame fades, new brighter tongues emerge from the top corner of the left plank.
A persistent flame tracks diagonally along the plank's front face and onto the bottom log, flickering continuously.
caption: The video captures a pile of split wood against a pure black background, with orange flames burning on the pieces. A diagonal plank on the left rests on a front horizontal log, while a cylindrical log sits behind and another plank leans right. Early on, a tall orange flame column rises in front of the left plank, its tip reaching above the top edge, accompanied by a separate tongue floating higher. This column wavers, narrows, and fades into thin dark wisps with faint tips by the middle. A flame running along the plank's front face and onto the bottom log persists throughout, flickering with a thin line tracking diagonally. Later, new, brighter tongues emerge from the top corner and grow upward after the high detached flame has faded. The wood pieces remain stationary, their grain and char marks fixed, while the flames and smoke provide all visible motion.
